# Desktop tools (C++, host only): the Darknet blob and weight tools, the YOLO checker and detector
# for each model, and the camera viewer. The library and the tests are in the root CMakeLists.txt.
# The YOLO tables (tools/yolo/*.inc) are generated by tools/yolo/yolo_export.py.

# Host tool: converts a Darknet model into an int8 model blob for flash (see ModelBlob.h).
# AVX2 for the int8 dot products of DotProductBackend (x86-64 only; the scalar code is used otherwise).
if(CMAKE_SYSTEM_PROCESSOR MATCHES "x86_64|AMD64")
  if(MSVC)
    add_compile_options(/arch:AVX2)
  else()
    add_compile_options(-mavx2)
  endif()
endif()

add_executable(tinyyolo_export_blob export_model_blob.cpp)
target_link_libraries(tinyyolo_export_blob PRIVATE TinyYolo)
set_target_properties(tinyyolo_export_blob PROPERTIES CXX_STANDARD 17 CXX_STANDARD_REQUIRED ON)

# Host tool: writes a Darknet .weights file matching a .cfg (sample models for examples).
add_executable(tinyyolo_make_weights make_darknet_weights.cpp)
target_link_libraries(tinyyolo_make_weights PRIVATE TinyYolo)
set_target_properties(tinyyolo_make_weights PROPERTIES CXX_STANDARD 11 CXX_STANDARD_REQUIRED ON)

# Host tools for YOLO11 and YOLO26: the same sources, one target per model (the operation table
# tools/<name>_graph.inc is generated by tools/yolo/yolo_export.py; the weights come from the same export).
foreach(model IN ITEMS yolo11n yolo26n)
  string(REGEX REPLACE "n$" "" family ${model})
  add_executable(${family}_detect yolo/yolo_detect.cpp)
  target_compile_definitions(${family}_detect PRIVATE YOLO_NS=${family} "YOLO_BASE=\"${model}\""
                             "YOLO_TABLE=\"${model}_graph.inc\"")
  target_include_directories(${family}_detect PRIVATE ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/../tools/yolo)
  target_link_libraries(${family}_detect PRIVATE TinyYolo)
  set_target_properties(${family}_detect PROPERTIES CXX_STANDARD 17 CXX_STANDARD_REQUIRED ON)
  add_executable(${family}_check yolo/yolo_check.cpp)
  target_compile_definitions(${family}_check PRIVATE YOLO_NS=${family} "YOLO_BASE=\"${model}\""
                             "YOLO_TABLE=\"${model}_graph.inc\"")
  target_include_directories(${family}_check PRIVATE ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/../tools/yolo)
  target_link_libraries(${family}_check PRIVATE TinyYolo)
  set_target_properties(${family}_check PROPERTIES CXX_STANDARD 17 CXX_STANDARD_REQUIRED ON)
endforeach()

# Desktop camera viewer: TinyCamera captures, TinyGPU shows the picture in an SDL2 window.
# The TinyCamera and TinyGPU libraries are built as subprojects from their own folders
# (sibling directories by default). Needs SDL2 (pkg-config name sdl2) for the window.
option(TINYYOLO_BUILD_CAMERA_VIEW "Build the desktop camera viewer (camera_view)" OFF)
if(TINYYOLO_BUILD_CAMERA_VIEW)
  set(TINYCAMERA_DIR "${CMAKE_SOURCE_DIR}/../TinyCamera" CACHE PATH "TinyCamera library directory")
  set(TINYGPU_DIR "${CMAKE_SOURCE_DIR}/../TinyGPU" CACHE PATH "TinyGPU library directory")
  set(TINYMD_DIR "${CMAKE_SOURCE_DIR}/../TinyMaterialDesign" CACHE PATH "TinyMaterialDesign library directory")
  find_package(PkgConfig REQUIRED)
  pkg_check_modules(SDL2 REQUIRED IMPORTED_TARGET sdl2)

  # The viewer needs only the capture (V4L2 on Linux, no JPEG) and the display.
  set(TINYCAMERA_USE_TINYJPEG OFF CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
  add_subdirectory(${TINYCAMERA_DIR} ${CMAKE_BINARY_DIR}/TinyCamera EXCLUDE_FROM_ALL)
  add_subdirectory(${TINYGPU_DIR} ${CMAKE_BINARY_DIR}/TinyGPU EXCLUDE_FROM_ALL)

  add_executable(camera_view camera_view/camera_view.cpp)
  # TinyMaterialDesign is header-only: its src folder is added, and its TinyGPU dependency is
  # the TinyGPU::TinyGPU target above.
  target_include_directories(camera_view PRIVATE ${TINYMD_DIR}/src)
  target_link_libraries(camera_view PRIVATE TinyYolo TinyCamera::TinyCamera TinyGPU::TinyGPU PkgConfig::SDL2)
  set_target_properties(camera_view PROPERTIES CXX_STANDARD 17 CXX_STANDARD_REQUIRED ON)

  # The convolution kernels vectorize best for the machine they run on.
  option(TINYYOLO_NATIVE_ARCH "Optimise the desktop viewer for this machine (-march=native)" ON)
  if(TINYYOLO_NATIVE_ARCH)
    target_compile_options(camera_view PRIVATE -march=native)
  endif()
endif()

# Darknet models (.cfg, .names, .weights) on the host, through TinyYoloModel as on the boards.
add_executable(darknet_detect darknet/darknet_detect.cpp)
target_link_libraries(darknet_detect PRIVATE TinyYolo)
set_target_properties(darknet_detect PROPERTIES CXX_STANDARD 17 CXX_STANDARD_REQUIRED ON)
